claims: Mason Howell is an American golfer.
As of April 2026, Mason Howell is 18 years old.
Mason Howell was born on June 28, 2007.
Mason Howell is a high school senior from Thomasville, Georgia.
Mason Howell is the third-youngest winner of the U.S. Amateur in 2025.
Mason Howell is competing as an amateur in the 2026 Masters.
Mason Howell is a high school senior graduating in 2026.
Mason Howell is committed to the University of Georgia.
Mason Howell is the 2025 U.S. Amateur Champion.
Mason Howell is a 2025 Walker Cup competitor
